senate.label: Senate
senate.note: How control works: 51 seats wins it. At 50 to 50 the Vice President, a Republican, breaks the tie, so 50 is enough for Republicans. Independents who sit with the Democrats are counted with them.

house.label: House
house.note: Every House seat is on the ballot. Each tile is one seat, all the same size; where a tile sits inside its state is approximate.

president.label: President
president.note: There is no race for President this year. This is the certified 2024 result, to compare the night against.
president.source: Wikipedia, '2024 United States presidential election', section 'Results by state' (wikitext read 2026-10-29 via https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2024_United_States_presidential_election&action=raw); table compiled from each state's certified canvass, cross-referenced to AP final results (Jan 2, 2025) and the FEC. ME and NE: statewide votes; ev splits include district results (ME-2 to Trump, NE-2 to Harris). Cross-checked 2026-10-29 state by state against the FEC official results PDF (https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/2024presgeresults.pdf, Jan 16 2025): all 51 match on Trump, Harris, total and EV except Virginia, where FEC prints R 2,074,097 / D 2,333,778 / total 4,503,288; kept Virginia Dept of Elections official figures (R 2,075,085 / D 2,335,395 / total 4,505,941) as used by Wikipedia. Virginia uses the FEC official 2024 results (16 Jan 2025), which differ slightly from Wikipedia.
